senses.gloss: औद्धत्य n. (fr. उद्-धत), arrogance, insolence, overbearing manner, disdain, Kathās.; Sāh.
(with Buddhists) self-exaltation (one of the 10 fetters which bind a man to existence), MWB. 127
औद्धव m. pl. (fr. उद्-धव), grass left over of the sacrificial straw, ĀpŚr. viii, 14, 4
औद्धव mf(ई)n. consisting of such grass, ĀpŚr. viii, 14, 5
coming from or spoken by Uddhava, relating to Uddhava, Śiś. ii, 118.
औद्धव—मय mfn. id. Comm. on ib.
औद्धारिक mfn. (fr. उद्-धार), belonging to or forming the part to be set aside, Mn. ix, 150.
